description.zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. Create and view it in the console. You can specify only one ID.
Number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. You should call this operation only as needed.
